title: Vivek Ramaswamy co-founded Strive
summary: Current first-party history identifies Vivek Ramaswamy and Anson Frericks as Strive's 2022 founders; the relation is historical and does not imply a current operating role.

data.subject: starintel:person:vivek-ramaswamy
data.note: Strive's current first-party history states that Strive was founded in 2022 by Vivek Ramaswamy and Anson Frericks, and separately states that the later Asset Entities merger formed Strive, Inc. Treat this as corporate-lineage founder history, not a current executive-role assertion.
